content.text: KAUN-O me nanmwarki! Sampah, ke en nsenamwahu!
Perenda, kumwail deke kan en nan madau!
Depwek oh rotorot mosul kin kapilpene ih;
e kin ketin kaunda ni pwuhng oh mehlel.
Kisiniei kin tieng mwowe
oh kamwakamwasika sapwellime imwintihti kan me kapilpene.
Sapwellime lioal kin kamarainihada sampah;
sampah kin kilang oh kin rerrerki.
Dohl akan kin peipeseng rasehng kirihs mwohn silangin KAUN-O,
mwohn silangin Kaunen sampah pokon.
Nanleng kan kin lohkiseli sapwellime pwuhng,
oh wehi koaros kin kilang sapwellime lingaling.
Irail koaros me kin pwongih dikedik en eni kan kin namenekla;
oh koht akan koaros kin poaridi mwohn KAUN-O.
Maing KAUN, pwehki sapwellimomwi kopwung kan
tohn Saion kan kin nsenamwahula,
oh kahnimw en Suda kan kin perenda,
Maing KAUN, Wasa Lapalap, komwi me kin kaunda sampah pokon;
komwi ketin lapalap sang koht akan koaros.
KAUN-O kin ketin loalloale irail kan me kin kailongki me suwed;
e kin ketin sinsile mour en sapwellime aramas akan;
e kin ketin kapitirailla sang pahn manaman en aramas suwed kan.
Marain kin dakedaker pohn aramas pwung kan,
oh nsenamwahu pohn me mwahu kan.
Kumwail koaros me pwung kan, kumwail nsenamwahula
pwehki wiepen nin limen KAUN-O!
Kumwail tamataman dahme Koht me sarawio ketin wiadahr,
oh kapingkalahngankihong.
